description: Ministry of Foreign Affairs - Regulations of the United Nations (sanctions in Relation to Democratic People's Republic of Korea) - 2017
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs under the United Nations Act, imposing sanctions and prohibitions related to the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. It establishes legal obligations, prohibitions, and regulatory frameworks for compliance with UN Security Council resolutions, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions a minister by name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities or make personnel changes, so it does not qualify as a government-related type (1-3).
